concepts.title: Octants and Coordinate Planes in 3D Space
concepts.definition: Three-dimensional space is partitioned into eight regions called octants by three mutually perpendicular planes passing through the origin.
concepts.key_idea: The signs of the x, y, and z coordinates uniquely identify the octant containing a given point.
question_patterns: name the octant in which the point lies
find the octant of the point

concepts.title: Coordinates on Axes and Coordinate Planes
concepts.definition: Points located on coordinate axes have two zero coordinates, while points lying within coordinate planes have at least one zero coordinate.
concepts.formula: x_axis = (x, 0, 0), y_axis = (0, y, 0), z_axis = (0, 0, z), xy_plane = (x, y, 0)
concepts.key_idea: Coordinates perpendicular to a plane or axis vanish for points lying on them.

concepts.title: Distance Between Two Points in 3D Space
concepts.definition: The straight-line separation between two points in three-dimensional Cartesian space computed using the 3D Euclidean metric.
concepts.key_idea: Extends the Pythagorean distance formula from two to three dimensions.
question_patterns: find the distance between two points
calculate distance between points in 3D space

Explain the method of Distance Between Two Points in 3D Space.

solution_steps.explain: Subtract x1 from x2
Subtract y1 from y2
Subtract z1 from z2
Add squares of dx, dy, and dz
Take square root of dist_sq to obtain final distance

concepts.title: Distance of a Point from the Origin

concepts.key_idea: Calculates the magnitude of a point's position vector relative to the origin.

concepts.title: Collinearity of Three Points in 3D Space
concepts.definition: Three points in space are collinear if the sum of the distances between two pairs of points equals the distance between the outermost pair.
concepts.key_idea: Linear alignment of points is confirmed when segment lengths satisfy the triangle equality condition.
question_patterns: show that three points are collinear
verify if three points lie on a single line

Explain the method of Collinearity of Three Points in 3D Space.

solution_steps.explain: Use the 3D distance formula to find lengths AB, BC, and AC.

solution_steps.action: conclude collinearity if the equality holds
solution_steps.explain: If AB + BC = AC (or equivalent), the three points lie on a single straight line; otherwise they are non-collinear.

concepts.title: Geometric Classification of Triangles and Polygons
concepts.definition: Using 3D side lengths and diagonal lengths to verify geometric shapes like isosceles triangles, right triangles, or parallelograms.
concepts.formula: AB**2 + BC**2 = AC**2 (Right Triangle); AB = CD and BC = DA (Parallelogram)
concepts.key_idea: Geometric shapes in 3D are categorized by structural constraints on side and diagonal lengths.

concepts.title: Centroid of a Triangle in 3D Space
concepts.definition: The intersection point of medians of a triangle in three dimensions, calculated as the mean of its vertex coordinates.
concepts.key_idea: The centroid coordinates are arithmetic averages of corresponding vertex coordinates.
